'''Nar Haaska''' was a [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]. It was a part of the territory controlled by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] by [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]], and by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the world became a part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Attack on the Nar Haaska system|conquered]] the [[Nar Haaska system/Legends|Nar Haaska system]].

==Description==
Nar Haaska was a rarely visited [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Nar Haaska system/Legends|Nar Haaska system]], a part of the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. Nar Haaska lay on a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that connected it to the planets [[Saqqar]] and [[Droxu]]&mdash;in Hutt Space and the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], respectively.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
Nar Haaska was located within the territory controlled by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] by [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]], and the area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding the world was considered well-[[Scout/Legends|explored]] by [[8000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Thirteenth Army|Thirteenth Sector Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was charged with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in Nar Haaska's vicinity. By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the world was situated in the territory formally controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EGTW" />

The population of Nar Haaska around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered between 500 million to 1 billion. At some point between [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] and [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], the Nar Haaska [[Star system/Legends|system]] was [[Attack on the Nar Haaska system|attacked]] by the military forces of the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] species during its [[Yuuzhan Vong War|conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and the [[Star/Legends|star]] system remained under the invaders' control by 27 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|So I began penciling in new worlds. Some got Hutt-sounding names&mdash;Nar Chunna and Nar Haaska, for instance.|Jason Fry|<ref name="Suvudu">{{Suvudu|url=2009/08/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-mapping-hutt-space.html|text=STAR WARS: THE ESSENTIAL ATLAS &ndash; Mapping Hutt Space}}</ref>}}
Nar Haaska was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square T-11.<ref name="TEA" /> In a 2009 article published on [[Unbound Worlds|Suvudu.com]], Fry noted that Nar Haaska was among those Hutt Space worlds created for ''The Essential Atlas'' that received "Hutt-sounding" names.<ref name="Suvudu" />
